inputs.location: city + parcel + source/date, never generic Tehran defaults
inputs.plot: closed valid simple polygon, metre coordinates, north evidence, survey hash, road/access edges
inputs.authority_profile: issuer/date/permit/current-edition choices and jurisdiction, source hashes, per-clause applicability reviews
inputs.program: immutable confirmed owner program, questionnaire version/hash, per-unit counts/bedrooms/usable area targets and hard/preferred distinction
inputs.typical_floor_schedule: explicit unique floor ids and identical-residential assertion; mixed residential floors reject V1
inputs.reservations: known columns, cores, parking transfer dependencies, shafts and equipment/service access envelopes
inputs.weights: explicit versioned bounded nonnegative soft quality weights; never legal authority
inputs.seed: explicit deterministic integer, search budget and algorithm identity

derived_facts: validated envelope from authority-backed setbacks and permit; never percentage default
plot geometry measures with explicit usable/gross definitions
location climate lookup only when authoritative source found
required exit/access/lift profile after applicability qualification
owner program area budget with core/wall/reservation allowance derived from actual geometry

candidate_strategy.enumeration: Bounded core alternatives then area partition candidates; retain stable candidate IDs from normalized inputs + seed + strategy. Do not use source plans as templates.
candidate_strategy.geometry: Exact polygon containment/disjointness and minimum widths; preserve holes/courts, test rotation invariance, metre units.
candidate_strategy.reconstruction_integration: Existing canonical3.0 describes recognized source evidence. Proposed generated objects require a future explicit generated-origin adapter and independent validator; no fake DXF witness handles.
candidate_strategy.determinism: Sort variable domains and candidates; fixed numeric policy, dependency hashes, rulebook/source/program/reservation versions; stable tie-break by candidate ID.
candidate_strategy.cost: No AI call in deterministic geometry/rule checks. Cache by full semantic input+rules+build hash. Bounded search with progress and cancellation; exhausted budget is REVIEW_REQUIRED, not mathematical infeasibility.

hard_gate: complete applicable rule inventory and qualified current authority
required furniture and equipment usability where program hard

metric_contract.missing: Do not replace unavailable metric with zero or a favorable score; mark INPUT_REQUIRED or omit only by explicit objective contract.
metric_contract.weights: Owner/project policy preferences; law cannot be traded against weighted score.
metric_contract.ranking: Reject failed/unknown hard gate before weighted score; report each component and tradeoff independently.

infeasibility.proof: NO_FEASIBLE_LAYOUT only with complete finite search/certified infeasibility and binding constraint IDs. Unknown authority -> INPUT_REQUIRED; incompatible authority -> CONFLICT; heuristic timeout -> REVIEW_REQUIRED.
infeasibility.explanation: Identify binding legal/program/geometry constraints and source refs, identify smallest tested owner-controlled relaxations with alternative outcomes; never recommend waiving law.

drawing: metre units and explicit output scale
project title and automatic build/revision identity
output_contract.validation: per-rule input/source/clause/applicability/result/failure geometry, candidate scoring, review reasons and completeness
output_contract.authority: VALIDATED means enumerated scope checks passed; construction issue still requires architect Golden qualification and responsible review. No automatic price or commercial area authority.

prohibited: unverified shaft inferred from white space
commercial measurement derived from target owner area

golden_contract.anti_leakage: No synthetic accepted architect plans; sample public study is heuristic evidence only.
